title: Fast Transformer Decoding: One Write-Head is All You Need
before: Every attention head kept its own keys and values, all cached during generation.
problem: The KV cache dominates memory during inference and throttles throughput.
breakthrough: Share one set of keys and values across all heads, shrinking the cache dramatically.
why: The start of the inference-efficiency line that runs through GQA to DeepSeek's latent attention.
next: Grouped-query attention in 2023 found the middle ground that Llama 2 and Mistral adopted.
inherits: KV cache design, the main memory constraint when you serve a model.
